children: AYTU BIOPHARMA, INC reported fiscal 2026 net revenue of $57.57M, down 13.3% from $66.38M a year earlier, and a net loss of ($14.25M) with diluted EPS of ($1.16) — results disclosed in its 10-K for the year ended 2026.
¹ Reported as “Net revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per share”.
Launched EXXUA (gepirone) in FY2026, generating $6.6M in initial sales and representing the company’s strategic shift toward prescription CNS products.
Net revenue decline was partially offset by EXXUA’s launch as management redirected resources from pediatric and legacy ADHD products to EXXUA commercialization.
Completed divestiture of the Consumer Health business, wound down non-core clinical programs, and transitioned Adzenys/Cotempla manufacturing to a U.S. contract manufacturer.
Maintained product availability with no reported EXXUA or ADHD stock outages; faces potential generic challenge to Adzenys through Paragraph IV litigation.
